content.thinking: I'll dig into the anomalies: the two out-of-period journals, the mismatched payment-invoice pair, the reversing journal, and the memo/SRC_REF fields.

input.sql: SELECT h.*, p."STRT_DT", p."END_DT", p."CLOSE_DT", p."STAT_CD" pstat FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE h."POST_DT"<p."STRT_DT" OR h."POST_DT">p."END_DT" OR h."POST_DT">p."CLOSE_DT" OR h."REF_JRNL_NO" IS NOT NULL OR h."JRNL_NO"=2439
SELECT p.*, i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD", i."INV_DT", i."JRNL_NO" FROM "APPAYM" p JOIN "APINVH" i ON i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID" WHERE p."PAY_AMT"<>i."INV_AMT"
SELECT "SRC_CD", "SRC_REF", count(*) c, min("MEMO") mn, max("MEMO") mx, min("JRNL_NO") j1, max("JRNL_NO") j2 FROM "GLJRNH" GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT h."SRC_CD", l."ACCT_CD", count(*) c, sum("DR_AMT") dr, sum("CR_AMT") cr FROM "GLJRNL" l JOIN "GLJRNH" h USING ("JRNL_NO") GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
